description: Mapped in a detailed OSM survey of the static line at the Keegsdijkje
Mapped in a detailed OSM survey of the static line at the Keegsdijkje
Fokker-built; listed by the International F-104 Society as a pole-mounted gate guard at Leeuwarden
OSM describes it as a fighter of the former German Democratic Republic so the operator is recorded as East Germany's successor code DE
Mapped alongside the MiG-21SPS; both are ex-East German aircraft on the west side of the base
